as_of_rule: oldest GetItem read date over the identifiers used
words: DB-b-286 (round 148, workstream CLASS, worker 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_DASHBD~230) changes account_class_daily.py, its class contract and the reporting-gold handler's class stage. ClassTable takes an injectable clock (default: the UTC run-day) and stamps every GetItem it makes, an absent item included, in read_dates; a cached lookup neither re-stamps nor re-reads. ClassTable.as_of(identifiers=None) answers the oldest stamp over the identifiers read, or None when none was read. emit_class_day takes classification_as_of and writes class_source.as_of and class_source.claim (held) into the day's manifest; the earlier class_source keys are unchanged. The class contract is 0.1.1 and gains exactly as_of and claim in class_source. The eight pure functions keep their exact source. Per amendment 1 of the order, class_days builds one ClassTable per run, keeps it in the module global _CLASS_TABLE and reads through it, and emit_classes dates each manifest from that table's as_of(). The new test file holds thirteen passing tests: six sum-to-account tests with the account values given independently and a sub-cent residual, each run alone against the four class_contribution mutants, and seven dating tests. Not proven: that the deployed function writes the date, which is a later code-update pair; and that any reader reads it.
